This is a pure UI refactor of drag/swipe gesture math — moving `project` and `rubberband` from a component to `lib.ts`, and extracting a `decideSwipe` decision helper. All inputs are numeric pointer coordinates/timestamps; the output is one of three literal strings that the caller uses to trigger local UI actions (save/context/settle). There are no new sinks touched: no I/O, no exec, no SQL, no filesystem, no logging of user data, no auth/authz decisions, no HTML rendering, no outbound requests, no template interpolation. Division-by-zero paths in `project` and the velocity calculation are guarded (`decelerationRate` defaults to 0.998; velocity guard is `last.t > first.t`) and even if they weren't, `NaN` propagates to "settle" — not a security-relevant outcome.

No source→sink path exists in this diff.
